basis: prospective resource allocation frozen by EP0 scope; not a runtime prediction or authorization to consume later budgets
cap_status: PAUSED_RESOURCE_CAP separate from scientific outcome; preserve roots; explicit prospective authorization required for any increase

queue.fencing_token: monotonic per attempt; expired worker commit rejected
queue.oom: halve target batch then alpha chunk in fixed candidates; no dtype/M/model/target reduction
queue.result: immutable validated file then transactional complete
queue.resume: validate hashes, reset expired claims only, exact task coverage
queue.seed: SHA256(namespace|task_id) first8 bytes; independent of worker count
queue.stop: before new claim reserve full task_timeout GPU/wall/storage bound; if insufficient -> no dispatch

retention.all_images: raw endpoint/IG/gradient class maps; all unit/component summary rows; masks/effects/predictions/resources
retention.format: float32 signed RGB arrays, no display transform, lossless compression optional
retention.raw_atlas_and_component_maps: first16 frozen evaluation IDs only, all models; other raw maps computed for scalar/spatial statistics then discarded after validated per-task summary
